CONTENT.TITLE: About me
CONTENT.MOTIVATION: Hey, I’m Stephan. I get a real kick out of programming—turning nothing into something cool. Every day I pick up new tools and tricks to write cleaner, more efficient code. At Developer Academy I’ve already gained tons of hands‑on experience, and I can’t wait to tackle fresh challenges and bring creative projects to life!

SKILL_SET.CONTENT: I work with JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and SCSS and have experience with object-oriented programming. Currently, I’m learning Angular, followed by backend development, while always eager to explore new technologies and expand my skills.

PROJECTS.TITLE: MY CRAFT
PROJECTS.SUBTITLE: Projects
PROJECTS.DESCRIPTION: Feel free to check out my projects and try them out yourself. I care about making sure they don’t just look good, but also work smoothly on any device. Clean, efficient code and a user experience that’s enjoyable are always my priorities.
PROJECTS.JOIN_DESCRIPTION: Task manager inspired by the Kanban System. Create and organize tasks using drag and drop functions, assign users and categories.
PROJECTS.EL_POLLO_LOCCO_DESCRIPTION: Jump, run and throw game based on object-oriented approach. Help Pepe to find coins and tabasco salsa to fight against the crazy hen.
PROJECTS.POKEDEX_DESCRIPTION: An app with complete data on all Pokemon. It has a search function and many other features.

0.NAME: Martin Jaros
0.COMMENT: Stephan was a great support during the group project. He worked reliably, kept all agreements, and completed his tasks carefully. His helpfulness was especially appreciated — whenever there were coding issues, he immediately offered assistance and explained complex topics clearly. With his structured and calm manner, Stephan contributed significantly to the smooth progress and success of the project. Working with him was a very pleasant experience.

1.NAME: Paul Groß
1.COMMENT: I worked with Stephan on the (Join) project and found him to be a very reliable teammate. You could always count on him to complete his tasks responsibly. I especially appreciate his clean, well-structured code, which made working together as a team much easier and more enjoyable.

CONTACT.TITLE: CONTACT ME
CONTACT.SUBTITLE: Ready to work together?
CONTACT.CONTENT: I welcome every opportunity to connect! I am particularly interested in roles where I can apply my programming skills and my passion for continuous learning. With my expertise and enthusiasm, I am confident that I can make a valuable contribution to any team. At the same time, I am highly motivated to collaborate on new projects, further develop my skills, and create real added value.
